question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: 5The correct answer is** "urbanised."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **'urbanised'** means to make an area more urban, or to develop an urban character. (चरित्र में शहरी बनना) • **Example**: *The government **urbanized**__ the rural areas.* • This word properly suits the context. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage**: The world is becoming increasingly (1) __**urbanised**__ Since 2007, more than half of the world's population has been living in cities, and that share is ______ (2) ______ to rise to 60 percent by 2030. Cities and metropolitan areas are powerhouses of economic growth-______ (3) ______ about 60 percent of global GDP. However, they also account for about 70 percent of global carbon emissions and over 60 percent of ______ (4) ______ use. Rapid urbanisation is resulting in a growing number of slum dwellers, inadequate and (5)________ infrastructure and services, worsening air pollution, and unplanned urban sprawl. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Intensified**: means to make something stronger or more extreme. (तीव्रतर, प्रबल या उग्रतर हो जाना या कर देना) • **Example**: *The storm **intensified**__ as it moved closer to the coast.* • **Localised**: means to confine something to a particular area or region. (किसी बात को स्‍थान या क्षेत्र विशेष तक सीमित कर देना; स्‍थानीयकरण करना) __ • **Example**: *The outbreak of the disease was **localised**__ to one village.* • **Decentralised**: means to transfer power or authority from a central location to local or regional locations. (सत्ता या प्राधिकार को केंद्रीय स्थान से स्थानीय या क्षेत्रीय स्थानों पर स्थानांतरित करना) __ • **Example**: *The company **decentralized**__ its operations to improve efficiency.* 3e:Te37, The correct answer is **"projected."**
